messages:
anya: Heads-up: started staging bring-up for mosaic-lite embeddings (v1.0.0) — quick smoke looks off for semantic recall@1 on our short-query holdout.
benji: Ugh, numbers?
ravi: Can you paste the run command and minimal logs? I ran a quick int8 pass last night.
anya: Sure — run we used:
```
python eval_embeddings.py --model mosaic-lite --checkpoint v1.0.0 --quant int8_per_channel --holdout shortqueries --k 10 --batch 512
```
anya: Summary from staging run (short-query holdout): recall@1 0.61 (baseline 0.69), recall@10 0.84 (baseline 0.86), silhouette -0.03 -> -0.08.
benji: That's a noticeable drop @anya. Is this quantization only?
anya: We tested fp16 and int8_per_channel. fp16 matched baseline within noise (recall@1 0.68). int8_per_channel is where most regression shows up.
ravi: Can you drop the per-channel vs per-tensor logs? Also want per-language split — curious if it's English-only.
anya: Per-lang quicks: en r@1 0.62, es r@1 0.58, ja r@1 0.63 — all slightly down vs fp16.
anya: Quick numeric snippet from the eval output:
```
{"model":"mosaic-lite","quant":"int8_per_channel","holdout":"shortqueries","recall@1":0.61,"recall@10":0.84,"silhouette":-0.08}
```
benji: Any clustering visuals? UMAP or t-SNE — to check class collapse.
anya: Pushed a UMAP png to the run artifacts: link: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/3165012345/artifacts/umap.png
anya: Visual shows tighter blob for some anchors but one cluster collapsed toward center.
navi: @ravi — can you re-run int8 with symmetric clamp (clamp=6) and per-tensor quant to compare? small change might help.
ravi: Yep I'll queue two jobs: per_tensor_int8 and per_channel_int8_clamp6. Expect ~30m each on 1xA100.
ci-bot: Build 3165012345-eval completed — artifacts uploaded (metrics.json, umap.png, logs.txt) :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: Reminder — staging GPU pool currently at 70% — queuing long runs might delay other teams, tagging infra.
anya: Noted @sre-bot, will keep runs <= 1 hour.
benji: Also let's run a PQ+HNSW recall check on long-tail dataset (k=1, k=5). Sometimes int8 hurts nearest neighbor precision.
ravi: Added long-tail holdout to queue. Will include k1/k5, per-tensor and per-channel.
anya: Thanks — next steps: (1) compare per-tensor vs per-channel int8, (2) try clamp tweak, (3) run long-tail k1/k5 recall and per-lang breakdown, (4) decide if mosaic-lite needs q-aware calibration in the export pipeline.
benji: Sounds good. If per-tensor recovers, we can prefer per-tensor for now and note in release notes.
anya: Agree. I'll write a short summary after the runs and open a PR to annotate model catalog with quantization caveats.
ravi: Will post results here when jobs finish.
anya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
